content: अह् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> or €10 <ab>U.</ab> = अंह् <ab>q. v.</ab> --II. €1 <ab>P.</ab> to sing together, compose, celebrate. prepare. --III. €5 <ab>P.</ab> (अह्नोति, आहीत्, आह) To pervade. --IV. (a defective verb preserved only in five forms; आत्थ, आहथुः, आह, आहतुः, आहुः) .²1 To say, speak, mention. .²2 To acknowledge, accept, state. .²3 To declare, express, signify. .²4 To hold, consider, regard; स्थाणुच्छेदस्य केदारमाहुः शल्यवतो मृगम् <ls>Ms. 9. 44</ls>. .²5 To call.
